name: MicroInterpreter
role: Allocate tensors, invoke a model and access inputs/outputs.

name: Model
role: FlatBuffer model view; GetModel returns a view into caller-owned bytes.

name: MicroOpResolver
role: Interface for builtin and custom operator lookup.

name: MicroMutableOpResolver
role: Fixed-capacity registration template; capacity counts registrations, not model nodes.

name: RecordingMicroInterpreter
role: Interpreter variant exposing the recording allocator.

name: GreedyMemoryPlanner
role: Plan buffers using lifetimes and sizes.

name: MicroProfiler
role: Record and report runtime profiling events.

name: MicroResourceVariables
role: Allocate, read, assign and reset resource variables.

name: InitializeTarget
role: Platform initialization hook; use the implementation matching the application.

name: HELIA_RT_VERSION
role: Runtime header version string; does not identify linked kernel or compiler settings.
